name: Two PC-Minimal Nonlearning Graphs Do Not Form a Forbidden Basis
statement: The three-leaf star $K_{1,3}$ and the six-cycle $C_6$ are pc-minor-minimal partial cubes that are not learning-space graphs. They cannot form forbidden pc-minors for the class because learning-space graphs are not pc-minor closed and can contain $K_{1,3}$ as a pc-minor.
proof: Every proper pc-minor of the star is a path. Every one-step restriction of $C_6$ is a path and every contraction is $C_4$. All are learning-space graphs. The catalogued conditioning construction realizes the star inside a learning-space graph.
